mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.password, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.avatar_url, u.role, t.employee_id, t.phone_number, t.department, t.specialization FROM users u INNER JOIN teachers t ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}

SELECT u.id, u.email, u.password, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.avatar_url, u.role, t.employee_id, t.phone_number, t.department, t.specialization FROM users u INNER JOIN teachers t ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE u.email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teachers (user_id, employee_id, phone_number, department, specialization) VALUES (#{id}, #{employeeId}, #{phoneNumber}, #{department}, #{specialization})
